name: happones/kinetix
description: The hybrid framework for Laravel + Vue 3 + Inertia.js — fluent PHP APIs that render a polished shadcn/Vue UI, spanning backend and frontend.

suggest.dompdf/dompdf: Required only for PDF exports (^3.0) — when an Exporter sets format() to 'pdf'. Other formats (csv/xlsx) need nothing extra.
suggest.laravel/cashier: Required for the Kinetix billing feature (^15.0|^16.0). The billable model must use Laravel\Cashier\Billable.
suggest.laravel/horizon: Queue dashboard metrics for the Kinetix queue feature (^5.0). When installed, Kinetix reads Horizon's metrics; otherwise it falls back to the queue connection's own stats.
suggest.laravel/pennant: Preferred driver for the Kinetix feature-flags feature (^1.0). When installed, Kinetix resolves flags through Pennant; otherwise a native evaluator is used.
suggest.laravel/sanctum: Required for the Kinetix developer-tokens feature (^4.0). The User model must use Laravel\Sanctum\HasApiTokens.
suggest.laravel/scout: Search driver for the Kinetix spotlight command palette (^10.0). When a searched model is Searchable, spotlight routes through Scout; otherwise it uses a LIKE query.
suggest.laravel/socialite: Required for the Kinetix connected-accounts / social-auth feature (^5.0). Configure providers in config/services.php and kinetix.connected_accounts.providers.
suggest.spatie/laravel-activitylog: Preferred driver for the Kinetix activity feature (^4.8). When installed, Kinetix logs through it instead of its native store.
suggest.spatie/laravel-health: Preferred driver for the Kinetix health feature (^1.0). When installed, Kinetix surfaces its registered checks; otherwise a native set of checks is used.
suggest.spatie/laravel-medialibrary: Required for the Kinetix media-library feature (^11.0). Models must implement HasMedia; without it the media manager is a no-op.
suggest.spatie/laravel-permission: Roles & permissions for the Kinetix permissions feature (^6.0). Required only if you enable kinetix.permissions.
suggest.spatie/laravel-webhook-server: Preferred delivery driver for the Kinetix webhooks feature (^3.0). When installed, deliveries route through its tuned retries/backoff; otherwise Kinetix's native queued job is used.
